memberdef.name: XPm_RequestDevice

briefdescription.para: Request the usage of a device.

detaileddescription.para: A subsystem requests access to a device and asserts its requirements on that device. The platform management controller will enable access to the memory mapped region containing the control registers of that device. For devices that can only be used by one subsystem, any other subsystems will now be blocked from accessing this device until it is released.

parameterdescription.para: Target subsystem ID (can be the same subsystem)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code

memberdef.name: XPm_RequestWakeUp

briefdescription.para: This function can be used by a subsystem to start-up and wake-up a child subsystem.

detaileddescription.para: If the target subsystem has been loaded and is ready to run, it will start running. If the target subsystem is suspended, it will resume.

parameterdescription.para:
Specifies whether to set the start address.
0 : do not set start address
1 : set start address
Address from which to resume when woken up.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code
